name: Paleforge
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near frozen methane lakes.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Regular pulses leave ancient alien ruins aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
